payload.title: Reclaim unreachable objects after compaction on self-hosted remotes
payload.body: Compaction force-pushes a rewritten tasks-claims ref; the dropped (completed-task) commits become unreachable but linger in the remote's object store until git gc. github.com auto-GCs periodically so clone/fetch cost still drops (clone only fetches reachable objects), but a self-hosted bare remote (GHE/GitLab/Gitea) needs periodic gc to actually reclaim disk. Document the recommended server gc cadence (or a post-compaction maintenance hint), and consider whether the projection should hint it. Surfaced implementing auto-trigger-git-native-log-compaction.
